description: This file contains helper functions and constants for managing cgroups and resource configurations in Kubernetes kubelet, specifically for Linux systems. It includes functions for converting CPU and memory resources, handling cgroup mounts, and retrieving cgroup information.

methods.name: MilliCPUToQuota
methods.description: Converts milliCPU to CFS quota and period values in microseconds, considering feature gate for quota period.

methods.name: MilliCPUToShares
methods.description: Converts milliCPU to CFS shares, respecting minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: HugePageLimits
methods.description: Converts resource list to a map of huge page size to limits.

methods.name: ResourceConfigForPod
methods.description: Generates resource configuration for a pod, including CPU shares, quota, memory, and huge page limits.

methods.name: GetCgroupSubsystems
methods.description: Returns information about mounted cgroup v1 or v2 subsystems depending on system mode.

methods.name: GetPodCgroupNameSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix of the pod's cgroup name based on UID.

methods.name: NodeAllocatableRoot
methods.description: Returns the cgroup path for node allocatable, considering cgroup driver and QoS settings.

methods.name: GetKubeletContainer
methods.description: Returns the cgroup path used by kubelet, defaulting to current process if not specified.

methods.name: CPURequestsFromConfig
methods.description: Extracts CPU request quantity from resource config.

methods.name: CPULimitsFromConfig
methods.description: Extracts CPU limit quantity from resource config.

methods.name: MemoryLimitsFromConfig
methods.description: Extracts memory limit quantity from resource config.

methods.name: sharesToMilliCPU
methods.description: Converts CPU shares to milli-CPU value.

methods.name: quotaToMilliCPU
methods.description: Converts cfs_quota and cfs_period to milli-CPU.
